history.summary: Large, spacious 1,378 sqft 3BR in Bedok South at $1,269 PSF — squarely in line with the last-12-month transacted average (~$1,258 PSF) — with a 6.67% appreciation rate over a credible 55 txns and TEL access via Siglap/Bayshore. Solid value with a real infrastructure catalyst, capped by the ageing 99-yr lease and large-unit liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified Casafina 3BR transactions average ~$1,258 PSF, so $1,269 is fair, not stretched. 6.67% URA CAGR on 55 txns is both strong and reliable, and the TEL (Siglap/Bayshore) plus Bayshore precinct are concrete catalysts. The 2000-vintage 99-yr lease and 1,378 sqft size (pushing price to $1.75M) are the main caveats.
red_flags: 1,378 sqft 3BR is large, narrowing buyer pool at $1.75M
Siglap MRT is ~990m, not walk-up close
catalysts: Thomson-East Coast Line (Siglap/Bayshore TEL) within walking distance
